question: What action can one who has abandoned tongue and genitals perform?
premises: Abandoning tongue and genitals ends binding action.
Brahman resides in the heart of the wise.
Non-dual knowledge frees from merit and demerit.
inference: Such a renouncer is not bound by karma.
uncertainties: Whether parityāgī is literal or symbolic.
plain_english: One who has abandoned tongue and genitals—what will he do by action?
